Visa regime for entering Serbia
VISA REGIME
For holders of diplomatic and official passports:
No visas required for visits of up to 90 days
For holders of ordinary passports*:
No visas required for visits of up to 90 days *Citizens of Montenegro can travel to Serbia with ID card or other document which can be used for identity and citizenship.
